# Accuracy by exposures across age {#sec-exposure-age} ::: {.callout-important} ## AI-generated — not for publication The code and prose in this book were written by an AI agent under human direction; they have not been verified line by line and must not be published or cited as-is. ::: ::: {.callout-warning} ## Preliminary & unvetted analysis Exploratory analysis. Exposure counts were hand-coded from import scripts and source papers and are still being checked; see the confidence column in `metadata/exposure_design.csv`. ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} library(tidyverse) library(here) i_am("notebooks/04-exposure-by-age.qmd") # _quarto.yml would otherwise make notebooks/ the root library(lme4) library(lmerTest) library(broom.mixed) theme_set(theme_classic(base_size = 12)) novel_trials <- read_csv(here("data", "derived", "novel_trials.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE) AGE_BREAKS <- c(12, 18, 24, 30, 36, 60) ``` ::: ## The model $$ \text{acc}_{ij} = \beta_0 + \beta_1 \log(T_{ij} + 1) + \beta_2 \log(\text{age}_i / 24) + \beta_3 \log(T_{ij} + 1)\log(\text{age}_i / 24) + u_{\text{dataset}} + u_{\text{child}} + u_{\text{word}} + \epsilon_{ij} $$ Here acc is long-window accuracy on test trial *j* for child *i*, and *T* is the number of teaching exposures to the target word before that trial. Age is centered at 24 months on the log scale, so $\beta_1$ is the exposure effect for a 2-year-old. The primary analysis uses **N–N test trials** only, restricted to 12–36 months (ages up to 60 months are shown in the descriptives). Trials whose teaching count is not yet coded (external teaching pending) are dropped and listed below. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} nn <- novel_trials |> filter(role == "test_nn", age >= 12, age <= 60) |> mutate(age_bin = cut(age, AGE_BREAKS, right = FALSE, include.lowest = TRUE), log_teaching = log(teaching + 1), log_age = log(age / 24)) nn |> filter(is.na(teaching)) |> count(dataset_name, name = "trials_with_uncoded_teaching") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} nn <- nn |> filter(!is.na(teaching)) ``` ::: ## Coverage How many trials, children, and datasets support each cell of the exposures × age grid? ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} nn |> summarise(n_trials = n(), n_children = n_distinct(subject_id), n_datasets = n_distinct(dataset_name), .by = c(age_bin, teaching)) |> arrange(age_bin, teaching) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} nn |> ggplot(aes(x = age, y = teaching + 1, colour = dataset_name)) + geom_jitter(width = .3, height = .03, alpha = .3, size = .8) + scale_y_log10(breaks = c(1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 17, 33), labels = \(x) x - 1) + labs(x = "Age (months)", y = "Teaching exposures (log scale)", colour = "Dataset") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Number of N–N test trials by teaching exposures and age, colored by dataset.](04-exposure-by-age_files/figure-html/fig-coverage-1.png){#fig-coverage width=672} ::: ::: ## Descriptive curves Child-level means within each age bin × exposure cell, averaged across children. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} by_child <- nn |> summarise(acc = mean(long_window_accuracy), .by = c(age_bin, teaching, subject_id)) curves <- by_child |> summarise(mean = mean(acc), n = n(), ci = 1.96 * sd(acc) / sqrt(n), .by = c(age_bin, teaching)) curves |> ggplot(aes(x = teaching + 1, y = mean, colour = age_bin)) + geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = "dashed") + geom_linerange(aes(ymin = mean - ci, ymax = mean + ci), position = position_dodge(width = .05), alpha = .5) + geom_point(aes(size = n), position = position_dodge(width = .05)) + geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = .05)) + scale_x_log10(breaks = c(1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 17, 33), labels = \(x) x - 1) + scale_colour_viridis_d(end = .9) + labs(x = "Teaching exposures before test (log scale)", y = "Proportion target looking (200–4000 ms)", colour = "Age (months)", size = "Children") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Accuracy on N–N test trials by number of prior teaching exposures, by age bin. Points are means across children (±95% CI); point size is the number of children. The dashed line is chance.](04-exposure-by-age_files/figure-html/fig-curves-1.png){#fig-curves width=672} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} nn |> summarise(acc = mean(long_window_accuracy), .by = c(dataset_name, age_bin, teaching, subject_id)) |> summarise(mean = mean(acc), n = n(), .by = c(dataset_name, age_bin, teaching)) |> ggplot(aes(x = teaching + 1, y = mean, colour = age_bin)) + geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = "dashed") + geom_point(aes(size = n)) + geom_line() + facet_wrap(~dataset_name) + scale_x_log10(breaks = c(1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 17, 33), labels = \(x) x - 1) + scale_colour_viridis_d(end = .9) + labs(x = "Teaching exposures (log scale)", y = "Proportion target looking", colour = "Age (months)", size = "Children") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![The same curves by dataset.](04-exposure-by-age_files/figure-html/fig-curves-dataset-1.png){#fig-curves-dataset width=672} ::: ::: ## Mixed-effects model ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} nn_model <- nn |> filter(age <= 36) m <- lmer(long_window_accuracy ~ log_teaching * log_age + (1 | dataset_name) + (1 | subject_id) + (1 | target_label), data = nn_model) tidy(m, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # each age's curve spans the teaching range observed within 3 months of that age pred_grid <- tibble(age = c(15, 21, 27, 33)) |> mutate(teaching = map(age, \(a) { obs <- nn_model$teaching[abs(nn_model$age - a) <= 3] seq(min(obs), max(obs), length.out = 50) })) |> unnest(teaching) |> mutate(log_age = log(age / 24), log_teaching = log(teaching + 1)) pred_grid$pred <- predict(m, newdata = pred_grid, re.form = NA) pred_grid |> ggplot(aes(x = teaching + 1, y = pred, colour = factor(age))) + geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = "dashed") + geom_line(linewidth = 1) + scale_x_log10(breaks = c(1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 17, 33), labels = \(x) x - 1) + scale_colour_viridis_d(end = .9) + labs(x = "Teaching exposures (log scale)", y = "Predicted proportion target looking", colour = "Age (months)") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Model predictions (fixed effects) for accuracy by teaching exposures at representative ages, each over the range of exposures observed within 3 months of that age.](04-exposure-by-age_files/figure-html/fig-model-1.png){#fig-model width=672} ::: ::: ## Sensitivity Teaching varies mostly *between* datasets: most datasets have one or two teaching levels. Only `reflook_socword`, `adams_marchman_2018`, `fernald_marchman_2012`, and `fernald_totlot` vary it within the dataset. Two checks on the primary model: * **observed**: teaching counted only from trials present in Peekbank, without the reconstructed missing trials (@sec-exposure) * **within-dataset**: dataset as a fixed effect, so the teaching slope is estimated only from within-dataset variation ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} m_observed <- lmer(long_window_accuracy ~ log_teaching_observed * log_age + (1 | dataset_name) + (1 | subject_id) + (1 | target_label), data = nn_model |> mutate(log_teaching_observed = log(teaching_observed + 1))) m_within <- lmer(long_window_accuracy ~ log_teaching * log_age + dataset_name + (1 | subject_id) + (1 | target_label), data = nn_model) bind_rows(primary = tidy(m, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE), observed = tidy(m_observed, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE), within_dataset = tidy(m_within, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE), .id = "model") |> filter(str_detect(term, "teaching|^log_age$")) |> select(model, term, estimate, std.error, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ## Timing controls Teaching is entangled with when a test happens. Tests after one exposure come right after it and early in the session; tests after several exposures come later, after more tests. A flat or negative teaching slope could reflect fatigue or forgetting rather than a lack of learning. Three timing variables, from @sec-exposure: * **position**: `trial_order / session_trials`, 0–1 through the session (centered at .5) * **test number**: earlier tests of the same word in this session, as log(n + 1) * **trials since teaching**: trials since the word was last taught in this session, on a log scale. Defined only where teaching is part of the imported session (`adams_marchman_2018`, `fernald_marchman_2012`, `fernald_totlot`), not where it came from learning videos (`reflook_*`, `yurovsky_2017`) or an earlier session. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} nn_model <- nn_model |> mutate(position = trial_order / session_trials - .5, log_test = log(test_session + 1), log_since_teaching = log(trials_since_teaching)) ``` ::: Position and test number are nearly collinear within datasets, so they enter separate models. In `reflook_socword`, teaching is nearly collinear with both: learning trials and tests are interleaved in one fixed order. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} cor_or_na <- function(x, y) { ok <- complete.cases(x, y) if (sum(ok) < 3 || sd(x[ok]) == 0 || sd(y[ok]) == 0) NA_real_ else cor(x[ok], y[ok]) } nn_model |> summarise(n_trials = n(), prop_since_teaching_defined = mean(!is.na(log_since_teaching)), r_teaching_position = cor_or_na(log_teaching, position), r_teaching_test = cor_or_na(log_teaching, log_test), r_position_test = cor_or_na(position, log_test), r_teaching_since = cor_or_na(log_teaching, log_since_teaching), .by = dataset_name) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ### Descriptives ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} nn_model |> mutate(test_number = test_session + 1) |> summarise(acc = mean(long_window_accuracy), .by = c(dataset_name, teaching, test_number, subject_id)) |> summarise(mean = mean(acc), n = n(), .by = c(dataset_name, teaching, test_number)) |> filter(n >= 5) |> ggplot(aes(x = test_number, y = mean, colour = factor(teaching))) + geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = "dashed") + geom_line(aes(group = teaching)) + geom_point(aes(size = n)) + facet_wrap(~dataset_name) + scale_colour_viridis_d(end = .9) + scale_size_area(max_size = 4) + labs(x = "Test of this word in the session (1 = first)", y = "Proportion target looking", colour = "Teaching", size = "Children") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Accuracy by how many times the word had already been tested in the session, colored by teaching exposures, for datasets aged 12–36 months. Points are means across children; lines connect tests at the same teaching level.](04-exposure-by-age_files/figure-html/fig-test-number-1.png){#fig-test-number width=672} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} nn_model |> mutate(position_bin = cut(position + .5, seq(0, 1, .2), include.lowest = TRUE, labels = c("0–.2", ".2–.4", ".4–.6", ".6–.8", ".8–1"))) |> summarise(acc = mean(long_window_accuracy), .by = c(dataset_name, age_bin, position_bin, subject_id)) |> summarise(mean = mean(acc), n = n(), .by = c(dataset_name, age_bin, position_bin)) |> filter(n >= 5) |> ggplot(aes(x = position_bin, y = mean, colour = age_bin, group = age_bin)) + geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = "dashed") + geom_line() + geom_point(aes(size = n)) + facet_wrap(~dataset_name) + scale_colour_viridis_d(end = .9) + scale_size_area(max_size = 4) + labs(x = "Position in session", y = "Proportion target looking", colour = "Age (months)", size = "Children") + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Accuracy across the session (trial position in fifths), by dataset and age bin. Points are means across children (cells with fewer than 5 children are dropped).](04-exposure-by-age_files/figure-html/fig-position-1.png){#fig-position width=672} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} nn_model |> filter(!is.na(trials_since_teaching)) |> summarise(acc = mean(long_window_accuracy), .by = c(dataset_name, teaching, trials_since_teaching, subject_id)) |> summarise(mean = mean(acc), n = n(), .by = c(dataset_name, teaching, trials_since_teaching)) |> filter(n >= 5) |> ggplot(aes(x = trials_since_teaching, y = mean, colour = factor(teaching))) + geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = "dashed") + geom_line(aes(group = teaching)) + geom_point(aes(size = n)) + facet_wrap(~dataset_name) + scale_x_log10(breaks = c(1, 2, 4, 8, 16)) + scale_colour_viridis_d(end = .9) + scale_size_area(max_size = 4) + labs(x = "Trials since last teaching (log scale)", y = "Proportion target looking", colour = "Teaching", size = "Children") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Accuracy by trials since the word was last taught in the session (log scale), colored by teaching exposures, for the datasets where this is defined. Points are means across children (cells with fewer than 5 children are dropped).](04-exposure-by-age_files/figure-html/fig-since-teaching-1.png){#fig-since-teaching width=672} ::: ::: ### Models Each model adds one timing control to the primary model. The recency model can only be fit on the subset where trials-since-teaching is defined, so the primary model is refit on that same subset for comparison. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} f_primary <- long_window_accuracy ~ log_teaching * log_age + (1 | dataset_name) + (1 | subject_id) + (1 | target_label) nn_since <- nn_model |> filter(!is.na(log_since_teaching)) timing_models <- list( "primary" = m, "+ position" = lmer(update(f_primary, . ~ . + position), data = nn_model), "+ test number" = lmer(update(f_primary, . ~ . + log_test), data = nn_model), "primary (recency subset)" = lmer(f_primary, data = nn_since), "+ trials since teaching (recency subset)" = lmer(update(f_primary, . ~ . + log_since_teaching), data = nn_since) ) timing_coefs <- timing_models |> map(\(x) tidy(x, effects = "fixed", conf.int = TRUE)) |> list_rbind(names_to = "model") |> mutate(model = fct_inorder(model), n_trials = map_int(timing_models, nobs)[as.character(model)]) timing_coefs |> filter(term != "(Intercept)") |> select(model, n_trials, term, estimate, std.error, conf.low, conf.high, p.value) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} timing_coefs |> filter(term %in% c("log_teaching", "log_teaching:log_age")) |> mutate(term = recode(term, log_teaching = "log(teaching + 1)", `log_teaching:log_age` = "log(teaching + 1) × log(age / 24)")) |> ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = fct_rev(model))) + geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") + geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high)) + facet_wrap(~term, scales = "free_x") + labs(x = "Estimate", y = NULL) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Teaching coefficients (±95% CI) with and without timing controls. The teaching slope is for a 24-month-old; the interaction is the change in that slope per unit of log age.](04-exposure-by-age_files/figure-html/fig-timing-coefs-1.png){#fig-timing-coefs width=672} ::: ::: ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} pred_grid_timing <- pred_grid |> mutate(position = 0) bind_rows( primary = pred_grid_timing |> mutate(pred = predict(m, newdata = pred_grid_timing, re.form = NA)), `+ position` = pred_grid_timing |> mutate(pred = predict(timing_models[["+ position"]], newdata = pred_grid_timing, re.form = NA)), .id = "model") |> ggplot(aes(x = teaching + 1, y = pred, colour = factor(age), linetype = model)) + geom_hline(yintercept = .5, linetype = "dotted") + geom_line(linewidth = .9) + scale_x_log10(breaks = c(1, 2, 3, 5, 9, 17, 33), labels = \(x) x - 1) + scale_colour_viridis_d(end = .9) + scale_linetype_manual(values = c(primary = "dashed", `+ position` = "solid")) + labs(x = "Teaching exposures (log scale)", y = "Predicted proportion target looking", colour = "Age (months)", linetype = "Model") ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![Model predictions for accuracy by teaching exposures at representative ages: primary model (dashed) and with position held at mid-session (solid), each over the range of exposures observed within 3 months of that age.](04-exposure-by-age_files/figure-html/fig-timing-pred-1.png){#fig-timing-pred width=672} ::: :::
